evidence.why: Straight-line setup, numeric arguments, pointer assignment and audio calls.
Exact frame guard without a consumed-event latch.

facts.rationale: Corrects the baseline's unsupported one-shot guarantee while preserving initialization order and numeric-state ambiguity.
facts.value: Every call performs unguarded participant initialization: it resets demo-fighter allocation and all player slots, configures slot 0 with the supplied character and costume, player ID 0, numeric slot type 2, facing 0.0, origin position and demo-creation argument 1, replaces the retained pointer with Player_GetEntity(0), and executes four fixed audio calls. The local camera caller invokes it when the updated camera frame equals exactly 100.0; neither helper nor caller has a consumed-event latch, so one-shot execution is not guaranteed by this code.

evidence.why: Camera tests and fog threshold-before-increment branches.

facts.rationale: Clarifies the fog off-by-one boundary and preserves the independent camera guards rather than implying a generic 100-update removal.
facts.value: The camera process advances animation before independent exact-equality tests, in order: frame 120 dispatches event 0xD with argument 0, frame 100 initializes the selected fighter, and equality with the camera end frame invokes finalization then requests scene exit. A milestone and completion can execute in the same invocation; no local latch guarantees one-shot milestones. Independently, the fog counter starts at zero: invocations 1 through 100 increment it, and invocation 101 requests fog-GObj teardown because the starting counter is already at least 100.
